notes: Built from the UHSAA year-by-year boys basketball champions table through the 2026 season.
1943 had no state tournament and is therefore not represented.

Historical school names are preserved except for site-name normalization such as Cedar City to Cedar, Gunnison to Gunnison Valley, Layton Christian to Layton Christian Academy, Wasatch Acad. to Wasatch Academy, and obvious UHSAA spelling errors.
